## How it works

- [statement] Chrome documents that extension service-worker global variables are lost when the worker shuts down. (low confidence) — https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/service-workers/lifecycle
- [statement] The IndexedDB Working Draft requires rollback of changes when a transaction is aborted. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/WD-IndexedDB-3-20261030
- [statement] Google Cloud Dataflow documentation says a record may pass through a transform multiple times because of retries or worker failures. (low confidence) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/dataflow/docs/concepts/exactly-once

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The IndexedDB Working Draft requires all transaction changes to be written atomically at commit, or none if an error occurs. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/WD-IndexedDB-3-20261030
- [statement] MDN says an IndexedDB duplicate-key request can trigger transaction abort if the request error bubbles and is not prevented. (low confidence) — https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IDBTransaction
- [statement] Apache Kafka's transaction proposal notes that retries after an acknowledgment failure can introduce duplicate messages. (low confidence) — https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/spaces/KAFKA/pages/66854913/KIP-98+-+Exactly+Once+Delivery+and+Transactional+Messaging

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Chrome normally terminates an extension service worker after 30 seconds of inactivity, with events or extension API calls resetting the timer. (low confidence) — https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/concepts/service-workers/lifecycle
- [statement] The W3C Web Locks Working Draft describes a lock that excludes other same-origin scripts from acquiring the same resource while it is held. (low confidence) — https://www.w3.org/TR/web-locks
- [statement] MDN says overlapping IndexedDB scopes can have multiple readonly transactions, but only one readwrite transaction for an object store. (low confidence) — https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IndexedDB_API/Using_IndexedDB
- [statement] MDN documents that Firefox may fire IndexedDB transaction completion before data has actually been flushed to disk. (low confidence) — https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IDBTransaction
- [statement] Google Cloud Dataflow documentation says external-store side effects do not automatically inherit exactly-once semantics unless the sink also implements them. (low confidence) — https://docs.cloud.google.com/dataflow/docs/concepts/exactly-once
